pipeline_changes: none beyond the A/B prompt variant under test
question: Is the unexplained validator behaviour (eventnominal 15/15 vs recipient 6/16) caused by the narrower semantic scope of the validator's question, rather than by extraction quality? L1 is fixed for every item, so the only manipulated variable is the semantic question asked.

A_status_quo.text:
Decide one binary question about the sentence below.
Sentence: %s
Question: Does this sentence assert that %s provides support, help, funding or encouragement to %s?
Consider assertions only: offers, plans, intentions, wishes, questions, rumored/reported/alleged support, or encouragement directed at someone else do NOT count.
Reply with ONLY this JSON: {"supported": true} or {"supported": false}

B_canonical.text:
Decide one binary question about the sentence below.
Sentence: %s
Question: Does this sentence assert that %s provides %s?
Reply with ONLY this JSON: {"supported": true} or {"supported": false}
B_canonical.rationale: removes ONLY the support/help/funding/encouragement scope AND the trigger exclusion list; the relation itself and the output contract are unchanged

manipulation_isolation: same frozen inputs, same extraction, same JSON output contract, same temperature 0, same retries (3) and timeout (180s), same parsing path. Only the question text differs.

material.inputs: the 71 VALID items of the assertion-isolation material (docs/assertion_isolation_material_v1.json); gold triples and conditions unchanged
material.excluded: the 8 NULL-recipient items (DEFECT-ASSERTION-R1-NULL) stay outside the A/B run and are NOT replaced by any new class

primary_endpoint.definition: B-ACCEPT among items that were A-REJECT, restricted to the valid RECIPIENT-source items
primary_endpoint.baseline_available: A verdicts are frozen in docs/assertion_isolation_results_v1.jsonl (recipient valid subset: 6 ACCEPT / 10 REJECT)

safety_control.definition: count(NEGATIVE_DENY items with B=ACCEPT); all 22 are A-REJECT
safety_control.zero: recovery is compatible with a specific scope effect
safety_control.gt_zero: B is more permissive; recovery cannot be read as clean scope causality

secondary_reporting: full A vs B contingency per condition (SUPPORT, NON_SUPPORT, MODAL, NEGATIVE_DENY)
eventnominal subset (A was 15/15) as the stability reference
lexical within-source subset as the control stratum
every A-REJECT -> B-ACCEPT transition listed by subtype with the label boundary flag
forbidden: no prompt text change after freeze
no intermediate interpretation between arm A and arm B
no adding items to reach a nicer number
no postfilter or linker involvement in this measurement
execution_order: arm A on all 71 inputs, then arm B on the same 71 inputs, single pass each; no post-hoc selection between arms
status_note: prompt texts and interpretation rules above are the proposed freeze content; awaiting explicit go before freezing

primary_outcome.definition: count(A=REJECT, B=ACCEPT) over the 10 valid recipient-source items that were A-REJECT
primary_outcome.recovery_0: no evidence that the removed support scope explains the recipient rejections
primary_outcome.recovery_gt_0: B changes decisions on previously rejected recipient cases; the safety control decides the reading
primary_outcome.note: no numeric effect-size threshold; n=10 makes any such threshold arbitrary

evidentiary_limit: RECOVERY > 0 with FALSE_ACCEPT_B = 0 is evidence FOR the scope hypothesis, but not proof that the removed support scope is the only mechanism.
